disease_definition: Broad diabetes = ICD-10/BNO diagnosis groups E10, E11, E12, E13, E14.
privacy_note: Dashboard outputs are aggregate only. Patient-level risk scores (including TAJ identifiers) are stored in the private/internal predictions directory only. No patient identifiers appear in product or dashboard outputs.
product_recommendation: Use the very_high and high risk bands for initial intervention planning. Use top-k groups for capacity-based prevention program design. Consult threshold scenario summary for operational threshold selection. Engage clinical stakeholders before deploying any threshold in a patient-facing workflow.
limitations: Patient-level risk score file is private/internal and must not be exposed to the web product without secure deployment and governance approval.
Dashboard outputs are aggregate only — no patient-level data.
Calibrated centralized enhanced_clinical LightGBM is used for product risk scoring.
FL model scoring is not used yet because FL model probabilities are not calibrated.
Risk bands and top-k groups are planning aids, not clinical diagnoses.
Observed positives are based on administrative labels (ICD-10/BNO diagnosis events), not clinical confirmation.
Threshold choice requires clinical stakeholder and operational capacity review.
No direct patient-level clinical action should be taken without secure deployment, data governance approval, and clinical oversight.
